name: NUT midline carcinoma family member 1

function.text: NUTM1 encodes NUT family member 1. Its detailed molecular activity is not resolved by the reviewed annotations collected for this draft.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include NUT carcinoma; Porocarcinoma; CIC-rearranged sarcoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports rearrangement context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.
